GCE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ZONE.title: GCE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ZONE
GCE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ZONE.description: Allows requested domain to be in private DNS zone, works only with a private ACME server (by default: false)

GCE_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: GCE_POLLING_INTERVAL
GCE_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 5)

GCE_PROJECT.title: GCE_PROJECT
GCE_PROJECT.description: Project name (by default, the project name is auto-detected by using the metadata service)

GCE_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: GCE_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
GCE_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 180)

GCE_TTL.title: GCE_TTL
GCE_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)

GCE_ZONE_ID.title: GCE_ZONE_ID
GCE_ZONE_ID.description: Allows to skip the automatic detection of the zone
